name: laci
description: A file manager that knows which folders are projects, and keeps their agent history attached when they move.

scripts.test: pnpm -C ui build && node scripts/ui-state-smoke.mjs && cargo test --workspace --features custom-protocol && cargo build -p laci --features custom-protocol && node scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm -C ui lint && pnpm -C ui build && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features custom-protocol -- -D warnings
scripts.build:binary: pnpm -C ui build && cargo build -p laci --features custom-protocol --release
